note: Single source of truth for Swaraj AI's local model fleet. Read by scripts/setup-models.js, src/server.js (/api/models) and scripts/package-desktop.js (dist/latest.json). Without these models the workbench still runs on built-in templates; with them every route answers locally.

models.name: llama3.2:1b
models.job: General reasoning, chat, Q&A, bilingual drafting

models.name: moondream:latest
models.job: Weld beads, gauges, nameplates, inspection photos

requirements.cpu: 4+ cores; GPU optional — Ollama uses it automatically when present
requirements.disk: ~4 GB for models + ~300 MB for the app
requirements.network: Internet once for `ollama pull` (or USB sideload for air-gapped sites); fully offline afterwards

airgap: Copy .gguf weights via USB, then per model: `ollama create <tag> --from <file.gguf>` (see README-DESKTOP.txt).
